results.title: John Horan insists there is a ‘strong and shared commitment’ for integration after first meeting of steering group as chairman
results.description: John Horan insists that “there remains a strong and shared commitment across all three associations to continue progressing towards one association” after chairing his first meeting of the Steering Group on Integration (SGI) earlier this week.

results.title: Nuggets' $207M All-Star, three-level scorer named surprise trade candidate by NBA insider
results.description: The Denver Nuggets season is still questionable is terms of how it is going to go. That is why this long-tenured veteran could shockingly find his way on the trading block.
